title: GFly
body:
![https://i.imgur.com/zwB29lu.png](https://i.imgur.com/zwB29lu.png)

# Fly - Plugin


**General:**

**This is a small Fly Plugin with some Settings and Functions that all can be changed by you in the Plugin-Config and the Lang-Files.**

**Support from 1.7 to 26.2!**


**===================================================================================**

**Special Features:**

100% customizable
Very good performance

**Fly also remembers Fly Mode in Creative Mode so you don't need to use "/fly" again after going back to survival mode!**

Block Fly Mode Change in the CreativeMode!

**And many more......**

**===================================================================================**

**Commands:**

<details>
<summary>  fly - commands</summary>



* /fly -> [Permission: **GFly.Fly**]
* /fly <Player>-> [Permission: **GFly.FlyOther**]
* /flyspeed <Speed> -> [Permission: **GFly.FlySpeed**]
* /flyspeed <Speed> <Player>-> [Permission: **GFly.FlySpeedOther**]


</details>

<details>
<summary>  /gflyreload (gfrl) - command</summary>


**gflyreload (gfrl):**

* /gflyreload


</details>


**===================================================================================**

**Permissions:**

**OP-Permission:** GFly.*

<details>
<summary>fly - permissions</summary>



* GFly.Fly
* GFly.FlyOther

* GFly.FlySpeed

* GFly.FlySpeedOther


</details>

<details>
<summary>gfly.gflyreload - permission</summary>


**GFly.GFlyReload:**

* GFly.GFlyReload


</details>

**===================================================================================**

**Lang-Files:**

**Change Language:**

* Set the "Lang.lang"-Option in the Config.yml to your chosen Language


**Add a new Language-File:**

* Copy one of the Lang-Files and Name it like you will
* Change the Messages in the Lang-File
* Set the "Lang.lang"-Option in the Config.yml to your created Lang-File

**===================================================================================**

**Stats:**

[![https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/GFly.svg](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/GFly.svg)](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/gfly)</center>

**===================================================================================**

**This Plugin supports the Minecraft Versions:**
**1.7, 1.8, 1.9, 1.10 , 1.11, 1.12, 1.13, 1.14, 1.15, 1.16, 1.17, 1.18, 1.19, 1.20, 1.21, 26.1 & 26.2**
